definition.text: Whom God has given. (1.) An inhabitant of Jerusalem, the father of Nehushta, who was the mother of king Jehoiachin (2 Kings 24:8). Probably the same who tried to prevent Jehoiakim from burning the roll of Jeremiah’s prophecies (Jer. 26:22; 36:12). (2.) Ezra 8:16.

lemmas.gloss: Elnathan, the name of four Israelites
Gemarjah, the name of two Israelites
Akbor, the name of an Idumaean and of two Israelites
Delajah, the name of five Israelites
Shemajah, the name of twenty-five Israelites
